key: splits.sentence_key(reference) = text_norm.normalize(text, 'ko'); the -itn sets use the original reference of the same utterance id
order: sha256(key.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest() ascending over the keys of zeroth-train, zeroth-val and zeroth-test; held out: the first (K * percent + 50) // 100
gate_note: per training set and judged subset: utterances whose sentence is in the training set by the reference key and by normalize(itn.harmonize(stored text)), and speakers in common
